"""Force the networkx solver path on small hand-built cases."""
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from harness import *
import planning
from campaign import audit

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 2)
T1 = '2001:db8:1:1200::1'
T2 = '2001:db8:1:1200::2'
NET = '2001:db8:1:1200::/64'
S = {'web': 'tcp', 'dev': 'adb'}
disc = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('j', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i2', T2, T2, 'echo')]

def forced(job):
    planning.PD_EDGE_LIMIT = 0
    planning.PD_SECONDS = 0.0
    planning.PD_PHASE_SECONDS = 1e18
    return audit(job)

def normal(job):
    planning.PD_EDGE_LIMIT = 20000
    planning.PD_SECONDS = 12.0
    planning.PD_PHASE_SECONDS = 2.5e-6
    return audit(job)

job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
               requests=[request('a', 10, 'home', T1), request('b', 10, 'home', T1)],
               offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 2, 5, 'q', ['a', 'b'])])
a, b = normal(json.loads(json.dumps(job))), forced(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
ok &= check('duplicate requests primal', (a['plan']['resolved'], a['plan']['cost'],
                                          sorted(x['request'] for x in a['plan']['assignments'])),
            (2, 10, ['a', 'b']))
ok &= check('duplicate requests nx', (b['plan']['resolved'], b['plan']['cost'],
                                      sorted(x['request'] for x in b['plan']['assignments'])),
            (2, 10, ['a', 'b']))

# max flow zero through the networkx path
job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
               requests=[request('a', 10, 'home', T1)],
               offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 0, 5, 'q', ['a'])])
b = forced(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
ok &= check('nx zero flow', b['plan'], {'resolved': 0, 'cost': 0, 'assignments': []})

# quota zero forces no flow
zero = [{'id': 'q', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 0}]
job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
               requests=[request('a', 10, 'home', T1)],
               offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 5, 5, 'q', ['a'])], rq=zero)
b = forced(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
ok &= check('nx quota zero', b['plan']['resolved'], 0)
a = normal(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
ok &= check('pd quota zero', a['plan']['resolved'], 0)

# mixed services keep adb certificate
job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
               requests=[request('a', 10, 'home', T1, 'dev'), request('b', 10, 'home', T2, 'web')],
               offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'dev', NET, 1, 5, 'q', ['a']),
                       offer('o2', 11, 'web', NET, 1, 7, 'q', ['b'])])
b = forced(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
kinds = {x['request']: (len(x['send']), len(x['finish'])) for x in b['plan']['assignments']}
ok &= check('nx certificates', kinds, {'a': (1, 1), 'b': (0, 0)})

# deep quota forest through both paths
tree = [{'id': 'n%d' % i, 'parent': None if i == 0 else 'n%d' % (i - 1), 'capacity': 4096}
        for i in range(8)]
tree[3]['capacity'] = 1
job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
               requests=[request('a', 10, 'home', T1, 'web', 'n7'),
                         request('b', 10, 'home', T2, 'web', 'n7')],
               offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 5, 5, 'q', ['a', 'b'])], rq=tree)
a = normal(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
b = forced(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
ok &= check('deep quota primal', (a['plan']['resolved'], a['plan']['cost']), (1, 5))
ok &= check('deep quota nx', (b['plan']['resolved'], b['plan']['cost']), (1, 5))

# multiple offer quota roots
forest = [{'id': 'a', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 1},
          {'id': 'b', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 1}]
job = campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(disc)],
               requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1), request('r2', 10, 'home', T2)],
               offers=[offer('o1', 11, 'web', NET, 5, 5, 'a', ['r1', 'r2']),
                       offer('o2', 11, 'web', NET, 5, 9, 'b', ['r1', 'r2'])],
               oq=forest)
a = normal(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
b = forced(json.loads(json.dumps(job)))
ok &= check('two roots primal', (a['plan']['resolved'], a['plan']['cost']), (2, 14))
ok &= check('two roots nx', (b['plan']['resolved'], b['plan']['cost']), (2, 14))

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
